text: The crew measures everything it will measure in space. From here on, Canary compares each person with themselves, never with an average.
Tomás has a fast pulse and has barely had any water. Space sickness. The alert already comes with what to do.

when: Day 147, on the way to Mars
text: Helena's sleep, mood, focus and time with the crew have been slipping together for two weeks. None would matter alone. Together they do.
This storm really happened: the strongest in 20 years. The readings are NASA's records from that day. What if a crew had been in its path?
Tomás has a seizure. Earth will not know for 5 minutes. Hold EMERGENCY, pick Seizure and follow the steps.
That day the Curiosity rover measured radiation 51 times above normal. The chart is that record. The crew stays inside.
